senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; רָצָה)desire, will, good-will. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 27 כשאהיה אני עליהם אתה הוי בר׳ … אני בר׳ when I am angry with them, be thou in a conciliatory mood; and when thou art angry, I will be conciliatory, v. רָצָה.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:4">Ab. II, 4</cite> <he>עשה רְצוֹנוֹ כרְצוֹנְךָ וכ׳</he> do his (God’s) will as being thy will, in order that he may do thy desire as being his own; <he>בטל רצונך וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00515"><he>בָּטֵל</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:7">Tosef. Ber. III, 7</cite> <he>עשה רצונך וכ׳</he> do thou thy will in the heavens above; <cite ref="Berakhot 29b:17">Ber. 29ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>יהי ר׳</he> (abbrev. <he>יה״ר</he>) be it the will (of God), v. <cite ref="T00884"><he>רַעֲוָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 5b:12">Taan. 5ᵇ</cite>, sq.; a. v. fr.—<he>יהי ר׳ מלפניך</he> (abbrev. <he>יר״מ</he>) be it thy will.

senses.gloss: acceptable. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. III, Par. 3 (ref. to Lev. I, 3) כשם שאם אינו תמים אינו לר׳ וכ׳ as a sacrifice is not acceptable when it is not perfect &c.; a. e.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:8">Makhsh. VI, 8</cite> <he>מטמא לר׳ ושלא לר׳</he> makes susceptible of uncleanness whether it is discharged intentionally (by milking) or unintentionally (by spontaneous dripping); <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 6:8">ib.</cite> <he>המשקין … לר׳</he> the liquids which come out of them with man’s intention (by pressing); <cite ref="Shabbat 143b">Sabb. 143ᵇ</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:1">Makhsh. I, 1</cite> <he>כל משקה שתחלתו לר׳ וכ׳</he> a liquid the contact with which is welcome at first (e.g. rain washing utensils), though finally it may be unwelcome (injurious).
senses.label: c
